title: The Serpent’s Wake
lyrics: (Spoken):They say the silence... was the first mistake.The ground was flat. The ground was dead.And then... something woke up.(Verse 1)(Drums kick in—hard, slow tom-tom groove. Vocals are low, gravelly, almost spoken)I’ve been sleeping in the cold for a thousand yearsUnderneath the crust where the pressure shearsMy eyes open up and the dirt creates a sealYou want a god? I’ll show you something real.I push through the surface, the granite starts to crackI’m dragging my belly, there’s no turning backEvery inch that I slither, every muscle that I strainIs cutting through the rock, preparing for the rain.I am the heavy weight, I am the shifting sandI’m carving out the scars that you call your land!(Voice rises to a grit)Yeah, I’m carving out the scars that define your land!(Chorus)(Explosion of distortion. Full band. Vocals are melodic, soaring, rasping at the high notes)So look up!Can you see the colors bleed?I am the water and the fire that you need!I bridge the gap between the soil and the sunThe journey of the Serpent has only just begun!Don’t you speak my name in vainUnless you’re ready for the flood...Unless you’re ready for the rain!(Verse 2)(Bass-driven groove. Faster pace. Aggressive delivery)I found the frogs hiding, bloated with the draughtTickled their bellies just to hear ‘em laughAnd when they opened up, the water rushed outDrowning the silence, erasing the doubt.Now the rivers are running where my body laidThis is the price that the mountain paid!You see the green grass growing? That’s my skin.You see the storm clouds rolling? That’s where I begin.I make the law, I draw the line in the dustYou give me fear, I give you something to trust!(Screamed)SOMETHING TO TRUST!(Chorus)(High energy, crashing cymbals)So look up!Can you see the colors bleed?I am the water and the fire that you need!I bridge the gap between the soil and the sunThe journey of the Serpent has only just begun!Don’t you speak my name in vainUnless you’re ready for the flood...Unless you’re ready for the rain!(Bridge)(Tempo drops to a sludge metal crawl. Heavy, palm-muted chugging. Vocals turn into a guttural roar)YOU! BREAK! THE! LAW!You think you’re safe?You think you’re hidden in the shade?I’ll turn to lightning, I’m the sharpest blade!Swallow you whole!Down to the pit!Where the brothers lie!Where the fires are lit!(Breakdown)(Chaos. Feedback squeals. Double-kick drum assault)RESPECT THE GROUND!RESPECT THE SKY!OR WATCH THE WATER RISE!WATCH IT RISE!DIE!(Guitar Solo)(Fast, pentatonic shredding shifting into a melodic, harmonized lead—classic Stone Sour style)(Verse 3)(Music cuts out abruptly. Just the clean guitar from the intro. Vocals are breathless, tired, emotional)Now I’m tired... the work is done.I’ll slip into the deep, away from the sun.The waterhole is dark, the waterhole is deep.I’m just a monster trying to get some sleep.But I’m listening.Yeah, I’m always listening.(Final Chorus)(Maximum Volume. Wall of sound)So look up!Can you see the colors bleed?!I am the water and the fire that you need!I bridge the gap between the soil and the sunThe journey of the Serpent is never really done!Don’t you speak my name in vainUnless you’re ready for the flood...(Long scream)YEAAAAAAAAH!(Outro)(Feedback fades. Acoustic guitar strums the final chord)(Spoken, intimate):That’s why the people speak.Because I’m still here.(Echo)Still here.(End)
